<function name="CanBePickedUpByNPCs" parent="WEAPON" type="hook">

	<realm>Server</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Return true to allow this weapon to be picked up by NPCs.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
